items.t: Voted no on the AUMF (Authorization for Use of Military Force) in 2001, the only member of Congress to do so (2001).
items.q: California Democrat Barbara Lee was the only member of Congress to vote against the AUMF in 2001 and has introduced a bill to revoke it.

items.t: Said she supports President Joe Biden's withdrawal from Afghanistan.

items.t: Said in a joint statement that the US should seek an immediate ceasefire, or at minimum a temporary cessation of all hostilities in Israel and Gaza, following the Hamas attacks on Israeli civilians (2023).

bio: Mayor Barbara Lee brought a wealth of public service experience and deep roots in Oakland, to City Hall. From overcoming personal adversity – raising two sons as a single mother on public assistance, while earning degrees from Mills College and UC Berkeley to becoming an award-winning leader.
